submission.justification: Mixture-G2 with a 2 mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.873 ns among all tested configurations. This represents a 57.3% improvement over Mixture-G1 (2.044 ns) and a 34% improvement over Mixture-G3 (1.322 ns) at the same gap width. Testing at alternative gaps for G2 (1 mm: 1.042 ns, 3 mm: 1.051 ns) confirmed that 2 mm is optimal. The mixture is fully compliant with laboratory environmental and safety policies, with 90% gas recirculation recovery supporting sustainability goals. The recommended 2 mm gap falls within the required 1-3 mm range and delivers superior performance for the detector upgrade.
